title: Preserve equally informed comparators and distinct preparation mechanisms
statement: An ordinary kernel optimizer with the same acquired echo data ties selection. A finite-word fluctuation-response learner supplies a strong fixed-endpoint alternative and preserves its failed fixed-budget validation. Independent sparse internal loads prepare native profiles without identifying kinetics; ordinary internal pistons with those same ports match it. These constructions do not acquire a cheap baseline, joint reset, sensors or full restoration cycle for the ensemble theorem.
